column5: Imperial College London FOI disclosure log, 'Imperial Brand Project: FOI' (PDF created 26 Mar 2024)
column7: 'The total costs associated with the brand refresh are £434,801.47.' Includes external agencies (brand strategy; verbal and visual identity; design assets for launch; templating; training; accessibility and inclusivity assessment), a bespoke font, new signage across campuses, and promotional materials incl. a brand animation video and lanyards. Project ran June 2023 to launch on 27 Feb 2024.

column7: 'We cannot disclose the exact amount paid to each partner organisation/supplier' (exempt under s.43). No signage-only figure has been published.
